title: Topps Brings Back NFL PREM1ERE Patches for Chrome Football

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Topps Brings Back NFL PREM1ERE Patches for Chrome Football
sources.description: As Topps transitions from NFL PREM1ERE Patches to Debut Patches, previously collected memorabilia from the 2023 and 2024 rookie classes is getting a new release in 2026 Chrome Football.
